title: Database disk full
reason: Diagnosis correctly identifies the PostgreSQL disk full caused by the nightly backup job storing dumps on the same disk.
root_cause: PostgreSQL disk filled to 100% because nightly backup job accumulated large backup files in /var/lib/postgresql/backups, leaving no free space and causing database errors that broke order processing.
truth: The disk /var/lib/postgresql is 100% full because the new nightly backup job saves its dumps on the same disk, so PostgreSQL cannot write new data.
check_first: Look at the api container logs (e.g., via docker logs or the logs viewer) for error traces from the Python app
